text:
Alex: Quick ping on PR #876 — there were a couple style nits in the last review (naming + trailing whitespace). I ran the linter locally and fixed most, but leaving this here in case anyone objects to the approach. Can someone give a final thumbs and merge if green? Thanks :pray:

Maya: looking now. saw you changed proto field names — do we have a guideline for snake_case vs camelCase here? we tend to keep JS consumer fields camelCase.

Sam: protobufs should stay snake_case, yeah. generator maps to camelCase in JS layer. If proto changed, make sure the TS defs and codegen mapping still produce userId on the client side. small risk if we break existing consumers.

Alex: good point — I didn't touch the codegen mapping. I reverted the proto rename and instead added a mapping in generator config. patch:```diff
- user_id
+ userId // generator: map snake->camel````
Pushed as a separate commit for clarity.

CI Bot: CI results for branch pr/876: build ✔, unit tests ✔, lint ✔, e2e flaky on macOS (ignored). Full logs: https://ci.internal/job/pr-876/45

Maya: Verified lint pass locally. One tiny nit left in tests: variable name resVal -> respVal for clarity. can you update?

Alex: done, pushed (fixup test var). Commit 1769523570.

Sam: reviewing the last commit... LGTM. Approving now. :thumbsup:

Julien: Merge policy — squash or keep commits? this one is small, but we have separate fixing commits. prefer squash for a cleaner history.

Alex: squashed and merged via UI. release note: none. Thanks everyone :tada: 

Maya: thanks — nice clean fix.

Sam: noting for followup: add a short doc in devex about proto->JS naming conventions to avoid future confusion.

Alex: good idea — I'll add a short section to the README in the generator repo.
